raw_lines: Architecture Blueprint: Secure Control Plane
• Core Principle: Deterministic Harness Controls Probabilistic Models
• Pre-Hook Guardrails: Intercept dangerous commands before execution
• Post-Hook Validation: Verify code AST and scan for secrets before commit
• Dynamic Scaling: Eliminates empty space with zero vertical scrollbars
Code Lab: Pre-Hook Interception Engine
• Intent Inspection: Intercepts raw tool call intents before runtime dispatch
• Deterministic Policy: Blocks unauthorized commands in pure code, not fuzzy prompts
• Zero-Trust Execution: Returns strict rejection payload directly to model context
Comparison: Prompt Engineering vs Harness Engineering
| Engineering Dimension | Prompt-Only Approach | Secure Harness Control Plane |
| **Security Boundary** | Advisory system instructions | Strict kernel-level PreToolUse interceptors |
| **State & Scope** | Context window token soup | Explicit read/write file scoping & memory files |
| **Verification** | Fuzzy LLM self-evaluation | Deterministic Pytest & AST syntax verifiers |
| **Fail-Safe** | Model hallucination bypass | Hard fail-closed execution boundary |
